Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement. Bridge Loan Credit Agreement On October 22, 2026 (the “Effective Date”), Atlas Energy Solutions ProjectCo, LLC (the “Borrower”), a Texas limited liability company and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (the “Company”), and certain of its affiliates entered into a credit agreement (the “Credit Agreement”) with Goldman Sachs Bank USA, as administrative agent (“GS”), and the lenders party thereto (collectively, the “Lenders”), pursuant to which the Lenders committed to provide term loans in an aggregate principal amount of up to $424 million, with the ability to request up to $286 million of incremental commitments, subject to lender consent and other conditions. The Borrower expects to use the proceeds of such term loans to finance the purchase of certain qualifying equipment for two power generation projects, to reimburse affiliates for certain equipment costs previously funded and to pay related fees and expenses. Borrowings under the Credit Agreement bear interest, at the Borrower’s option, at a rate equal to either (i) Adjusted Term SOFR Rate plus 2.50% or (ii) the Alternate Base Rate plus 1.50% (each as defined in the Credit Agreement), with each margin increasing by 0.50% beginning six months after the Effective Date. The Borrower is also required to pay a commitment fee of 0.50% per annum on undrawn commitments and a duration fee of 0.50% of the aggregate commitments on each six-month anniversary of the Effective Date on which loans remain outstanding. The Credit Agreement contains certain covenants that the Company considers customary for a facility of this type, including, but not limited to, limitations on the Borrower’s and certain of its subsidiaries’ incurrence of additional debt, granting of liens, and making dispositions, investments and restricted payments. The Credit Agreement does not include financial maintenance covenants. The Borrower is required to make prepayments with payments received under the cost reimbursement agreements supporting the financed equipment, the proceeds of certain indebtedness, including long-term project financing, upon the issuance of certain equity securities, and upon certain asset dispositions and casualty events. The outstanding amounts under the Credit Agreement will mature 180 days after the Effective Date, subject to a one-time option to extend the maturity by 184 days upon the satisfaction of certain conditions, including the consent of the Lenders. To secure borrowings under the Credit Agreement, the Borrower and certain of its subsidiaries have pledged substantially all of their assets and the Borrower’s direct parent has pledged the equity interests of the Borrower as collateral to GS for the benefit of the Lenders. The Borrower’s obligations under the Credit Agreement are guaranteed on an unsecured basis by the Company. Borrowings under the Credit Agreement are subject to acceleration upon the occurrence of events of default that the Company considers customary, including, among others, the failure to pay principal or interest, violation of covenants, default on other indebtedness and the termination of certain material contracts. The foregoing description of the Credit Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Credit Agreement, a copy of which will be filed as an exhibit to the Company’s next Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q.
